mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goods ( goods_name, goods_intro, goods_price, category_id, stock_num, goods_image, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{goodsName}, #{goodsIntro}, #{goodsPrice}, #{categoryId}, #{stockNum}, #{goodsImage}, NOW(), NOW() )

INSERT INTO goods_review ( goods_id, user_id, content, level, like_count, create_time, update_time ,image ) VALUES ( #{goodsId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{level}, #{likeCount}, NOW(), NOW() ,#{image} )
mapper.update: UPDATE goods SET goods_name = #{goodsName}, goods_intro = #{goodsIntro}, goods_price = #{goodsPrice}, category_id = #{categoryId}, stock_num = #{stockNum}, goods_image = #{goodsImage}, update_time = NOW() WHERE goods_id = #{goodsId}
mapper.select:
select g.goods_id,g.goods_name,g.goods_price,g.goods_image,g.category_id,IFNULL(SUM(o.quantity), 0) AS quantity from goods g left join `order` o on g.goods_id = o.goods_id
and category_id=#{categoryId}
and goods_name like concat('%',#{goodsName},'%')
group by g.goods_id

#{dto.goodsId}

select g.goods_id,g.goods_name,g.goods_intro,g.goods_price,g.category_id,g.stock_num,g.goods_image,IFNULL(SUM(o.quantity), 0) AS quantity from goods g left join `order` o on g.goods_id = o.goods_id where g.goods_id = #{goodsId} group by g.goods_id

select g.goods_id,g.goods_name,g.goods_intro,g.goods_price,g.category_id,g.stock_num,g.goods_image,IFNULL(SUM(o.quantity), 0) AS quantity from goods g left join `order` o on g.goods_id = o.goods_id group by g.goods_id

select gr.id as reviewId,gr.user_id,su.username,gr.content,gr.level,gr.like_count, gr.image,su.avatar as userImage,IFNULL(lr.is_cancel, -1) as isCancel from goods_review gr left join like_record lr on gr.id = lr.target_id and lr.target_type = 3 and lr.user_id = #{userId} left join sys_user su on gr.user_id = su.id where gr.goods_id = #{goodsId} order by gr.like_count desc
select goods_id, stock_num from goods where goods_id in #{id}
